candidate: Anaxyrus canorus occupancy dynamics in randomly selected Yosemite watersheds, 2007–2021

scientific_anchor.focal_selection_reason: chosen prospectively for a discrete breeding-site metapopulation question in a conservation-relevant high-elevation amphibian; selection is based on life history and the response-independent monitoring design, not on inspecting released species outcomes
scientific_anchor.published_sampling_frame: Yosemite divided into 220 watershed units with 10–25 potential amphibian breeding sites each; six Merced and eight Tuolumne watersheds were randomly selected; all potential breeding sites in each selected watershed were surveyed
scientific_anchor.survey_semantics: independent double-observer visual encounter surveys at ponds, lakes, streams and meadows, recording adults and pre-metamorphic life stages
scientific_anchor.node_universe_boundary: the selected-watershed breeding-site frame is response-independent with respect to focal-species occurrence; do not add or remove sites based on Anaxyrus observations
scientific_anchor.source_process_boundary: the 14 sampled watersheds are only a random subset of 220 watershed units, so sampled-site internal dispersal is not assumed biologically closed. Before outcome access, an existing EOG-compatible exogenous-source representation or an explicit stop must be frozen response-blind; no external source is invented after observing colonization outcomes.

metadata_stage.purpose: resolve exact ScienceBase item/child/file identities, file names, sizes/checksums and physical separation of site/static geometry, dynamic covariates and species observations before any data file payload is opened

future_geometry_boundary.spatial_requirement: complete response-independent site coordinates or a complete pairwise distance/network representation for the frozen analysis nodes must exist as separately addressable public bytes
future_geometry_boundary.watershed_rule: retain published watershed identity; do not select watersheds using focal-species detections and do not invent between-watershed edges without a frozen response-independent geometry/source rule

future_endpoint_boundary.provisional_endpoint: one-year-ahead adult Anaxyrus canorus site occurrence, with survey availability and site existence fixed independently before response access; exact response columns and missing-row handling must be frozen from documentation/schema first
future_endpoint_boundary.learner_boundary: same frozen strong random forest and conventional features in both arms; augmented arm adds only unchanged symmetric_world_support_summary_v1
